topic: one click turns an empty room into a staged one for free
headline: Empty to staged. One click. Free.
visualSummary: Full bleed photo of a bright modern living room split corner to corner by a bright blue diagonal line with a soft glow. Empty above the line, staged below. Dark BEFORE pill top left, white logo pill top right, blue AFTER pill on the right at mid height. Two line headline bottom left over a dark scrim, white clause then bright blue clause. Blue Try free pill bottom right. Grey, white and pale wood tones with almost no colour beyond the blue chrome.

topic: one room staged five ways for five different kinds of buyer
headline: One empty room. Five different buyers.
visualSummary: Deep brand blue field. Logo lockup top left, letterspaced AI VIRTUAL STAGING eyebrow top right. Two line headline, white clause then pale blue clause, muted subhead. One wide hero photo of an empty white living room with a fireplace carrying a translucent Empty room pill. Below it five staged variants of the same room in a three then two grid, each rounded, each with a blue style pill and a white buyer persona caption. Footer with Free AI staging left and a white Try free pill right.
palette: brand blue field with warm wood

topic: empty outdoor space makes buyers skip a listing
headline: Buyers scroll right past empty patios. Here's the fix.
visualSummary: Deep brand blue field. Logo lockup top left, letterspaced eyebrow top right. Two line headline, white clause then pale blue clause, muted subhead. A wide before and after comparison card of a covered brick patio with BEFORE and AFTER pills at the outer corners and a circular drag handle on the seam, plus a white caption pill below the seam. Under it a second full bleed photo card of a coastal living room with a COASTAL style pill and a caption. Footer with Free AI staging left, Virtually staged and a white Try free pill right. Warm brick, wood and green foliage against the blue.
palette: brand blue field with brick and foliage

topic: rooms staged in the visual style of a famous cartoon
headline: The Simpsons Collection
visualSummary: Bright saturated yellow field, not the usual brand blue. Small grey letterspaced eyebrow and a large deep blue headline top left, circular logo mark top right. One wide hero card showing a living room redrawn entirely in flat cartoon style with an orange couch, yellow fireplace and primary colour armchairs, carrying a yellow LIVING ROOM pill and a white caption. Below it three smaller cards labelled KITCHEN, BEDROOM and DINING, each a photo blended with the same cartoon treatment. Small grey footer line. Playful, high contrast, nothing else in the account looks like it.

topic: a cluttered basement turned into a sports den by one custom prompt
headline: Empty basement? Game on.
visualSummary: Square format. Pale periwinkle field with a fine dot texture and a thin border frame. Huge uppercase outlined headline top left in navy then bright blue, with a football emoji at the right. One large photo card split left to right by a hand drawn wavy navy divider, cluttered wood panelled basement on the left and a finished sports den with a bar, swivel chairs, framed jerseys and a neon sign on the right. Dark BEFORE and blue AFTER pills at the top corners. A white speech bubble callout over the left photo. White footer card with a line of copy and a blue Free at Stagify.ai button.
palette: periwinkle dotted field with warm wood

topic: turning a floor plan into a photoreal room before the house exists
headline: Sell it before it's built.
visualSummary: A solid brand blue header bar across the top with a white uppercase headline and the Stagify wordmark. The frame is then split into two full width horizontal panels. The top panel is a top down floor plan render on a faint blue grid with a blue FLOOR PLAN pill. The bottom panel is the same space as a photoreal three quarter interior render with a blue AI RENDER pill, showing a fireplace, seating and a canopy bed. A white rounded caption pill sits across the bottom of the lower panel. Cool greys, pale oak and soft blue throughout.
palette: blue header with warm neutral render

topic: the whole upload to staged flow told as a three panel story
headline: The empty listing
visualSummary: A comic strip. Navy header bar with a white uppercase title and a small letterspaced subtitle, plus a blue starburst badge reading ONE CLICK top right. Three stacked panels with thick navy borders on a pale blue field. Panel one is an empty room photo with a flat illustrated stick figure and a white speech bubble. Panel two is a dotted field with the figure holding a phone, a drawn swoosh arrow, and a navy caption block. Panel three is a fully staged midcentury bedroom with a blue STAGED starburst and a disclosure pill. A solid blue footer bar carries the call to action and a middot separated feature line.

topic: an empty room does not sell and staging fixes it in seconds
headline: Empty rooms don't sell.
visualSummary: Top to bottom split rather than left to right. White headline and pale blue subhead sit over a blue gradient wash on the upper photo of an empty white brick room. A jagged zigzag bright blue band cuts across the middle carrying the letterspaced words 8 SECONDS. Below it the same room staged coastal with a teal painted brick wall, white slipcovered sofa, rattan armchairs and framed seascapes. Small white BEFORE and AFTER pills on the left edge of each half. A white footer card with a navy line of copy and a blue Stagify.ai pill, then a small centred tagline.
palette: blue gradient with teal brick and rattan

topic: watching an empty luxury room furnish itself in eight seconds
headline: 8 seconds ago, this room was empty.
visualSummary: Full bleed photo of a luxury living room with a cream sectional, marble coffee table, gold and black triptych and a sputnik chandelier. A soft vertical light seam near the right edge reveals the empty version of the same room behind a blue tinted dotted scrim, so the reveal runs vertically instead of diagonally. Large white uppercase two line headline across the top. Three small white pills along the bottom left reading STYLE LUXURY, a timer, and 1 CLICK, with a disclosure pill bottom right. A pale blue footer band carries a navy line, a grey line and the wordmark.
palette: warm neutral luxury with a blue tint
